crons.comment: Closes hours, opens and expires payment windows. Idempotent, so a missed or repeated run is harmless. Vercel signs this request with CRON_SECRET.

headers.comment: Applies to every response. The CSP is the important line: default-src 'none' means anything not explicitly allowed below is blocked, and the absence of 'unsafe-inline' in script-src is what makes it a real barrier rather than decoration. The page has no inline script or style, so nothing has to be relaxed for it.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()

headers.comment: Fingerprint-free asset names are not in use, so the immutable cache is deliberately not set here; a short revalidating cache keeps deploys honest.
